title: Selective inhibition of CDK7 reveals the influence of CDK7 on psoriatic CD4+ T cells
description: Purpose: The goals of this study are to compare the differential gene of psoriatic CD4+ T cells treated with THZ1 and DMSO Methods: RNA sequencing of psoriatic CD4+ T cells which treated with THZ1 (10 nM) or DMSO Overall design: Overall differential gene expression through RNA sequencing comparing THZ1-treated psoriatic CD4+ T cells with DMSO-treated psoriatic CD4+ cells
